dedupe_keys.name: china city level final energy consumption 2005 2021

description: The China city final-energy research team publishes estimates for 331 Chinese cities from 2005 to 2021. The deposit describes seven economic sectors and coverage of 30 fossil-energy categories plus four clean-energy categories. These city-level estimates derive from energy accounting and allocation, not direct metering of every local consumer. Figshare supplies a public ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. The annual tables can provide historical demand constraints for municipal energy-transition simulations and comparisons with model-pypsa or model-muse-os. A caveat is that allocation assumptions and statistical boundaries affect comparisons across cities and years. Users should distinguish final consumption from generation and primary-energy totals. Internal archive formats, individual values and consistency with current administrative boundaries were not checked by downloading the data.
